title: Cataract Extraction with Intraocular Lens (IOL) Implantation
description: CMS National Coverage Determination for cataract extraction (NCD 10.1). Requires best corrected Snellen visual acuity <= 20/50, or debilitating disabling glare/contrast sensitivity loss, significantly impairing activities of daily living (driving, reading, medication management), and reasonable expectation of visual improvement.

criteria.name: Best Corrected Visual Acuity (<= 20/50 Snellen) or Severe Glare
criteria.description: Documented best-corrected Snellen distance visual acuity of 20/50 or worse in affected eye, or severe disabling glare under Brightness Acuity Testing (BAT).
criteria.clinical_intent: Objective visual acuity threshold for functional impairment

criteria.name: Documented Impairment in Activities of Daily Living (ADLs)
criteria.description: Patient reports that visual impairment significantly interferes with essential daily activities (driving, reading, navigating steps, personal safety).
criteria.clinical_intent: Confirm functional disability directly attributable to cataract

criteria.name: Glasses Sufficient or Purely Refractive Lens Exchange Exclusion
criteria.description: Clear lens extraction performed purely for refractive error correction, or patient whose visual needs are satisfied with glasses without lifestyle limitation.
criteria.clinical_intent: Disqualify refractive clear lens extraction without functional cataract

cms_reference.document_title: Use of Visual Tests in Determining Need for Cataract Surgery
cms_reference.citation: Medicare National Coverage Determinations Manual, Chapter 1, Part 1, Section 10.1
